name: Mokuren Suzu
source:
The signboard girl of the cafe "Magnolia", who pretends to be Sayuri's older sister. She takes good care of her.

"I like it. I can't say it well, but... I feel young!"

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.net/creator/9677/article?mode=detail&page=3]official website[/url]]
